approaches.artDirection: Neutral studio background, real cocoa surfaces, restrained analytical labeling; no glossy confectionery advertisement.
approaches.camera: Controlled macro fixed tripod; matched comparison angles.
approaches.captions: Stable lower sentence-case phrases; avoid reflective chocolate highlight band.
approaches.composition: Single bar fills center; comparative pieces shot under matched geometry/temperature/lighting; separate fat-phase overlay instead of fictitious camera penetration.
approaches.hook: Two visibly similar pieces from same recipe; show potential difference without asserting unperformed experiment.
approaches.lighting: Broad soft source, reproducible specular reflection; raw footage needed before making performance claims.
approaches.metaphorVersusLiteral: Food surface literal only if actually captured; internal structure entirely disclosed model, not inferred from visible result.
approaches.microscopicModel: Independent flat schematic cutaway with solid-particle keys and two structural scales.
approaches.mobile: Familiar food readable instantly; diagram overlay needs a clean full-frame handoff.
approaches.motion: Real restrained food movement; diagrams animate only causal changes.
approaches.music: Consider sparse original pulse; compare silence during later mix testing.
approaches.narration: Kokoro af_heart under existing primary narrator policy; conversational precise delivery, no auditions or generated audio.
approaches.pacing: Exact 80 words; allow arrangement/network distinction to register. Editorial 35–41.3 second estimate, later measured audio determines authored timing; no threshold padding.
approaches.payoff: Controlled real fracture/surface shots if obtained, with analytical summary.
approaches.rights: Original authored material or original recorded food; no scientific figures, copied microscopy, commercial food footage or third-party music without specific provenance/license review.
risks: No footage exists or experiment performed
Different thickness/temperature could fake softness/snap comparison
approaches.sound: Optional original handling and isolated fracture recordings; silence through internal explanation; subtle tonal music could bridge transitions but risks food-advertising tone.
approaches.texture: Actual chocolate, not generated documentary food footage.
approaches.thesis: Start with the familiar tactile reality, then use clearly separate analytical overlays to explain it.
tradeoffs: Requires original capture and carefully matched conditions
Surface cannot diagnose polymorph; literal/model handoff can overload viewer
Food demonstrations must distinguish observations from research claims
approaches.transitions: Match cuts between real bar and flat explanatory field, explicitly marked model boundary.
approaches.typography: Compact neutral sans, separate specimen identifiers and spoken captions.
approaches.visualMedium: Original practical macro food cinematography plus flat explanatory overlays

approaches.ambience: No continuous room/kitchen ambience; absence of bed keeps structure legible.
approaches.artDirection: Contemporary material study: rich cocoa object on quiet smoky-lilac field; analytical insets are matte pale-lilac. No museum workbench, kitchen tutorial or luxury-ad montage.
approaches.camera: Mostly stable near-orthographic three-quarter external view; analytical windows flatten frontally. Small purposeful approach for internal distinction, never camera flying through molecules.
approaches.captions: Full exact narration in natural spoken phrases, stable dedicated lower reading area with restrained opacity transitions and no karaoke bounce/backplate by default. Protect can/enough/helps. Analytical disclosure uses separate persistent label, never competes with captions.
approaches.composition: One centrally dominant floating slab; one analytical region at a time. Persistent ingredient key identifies fat phase and irregular solid particles. Separate bounded inset distinguishes crystal arrangement from the larger network.
approaches.hook: Same generic recipe shown as one labeled ingredient identity beside two possible material outcomes; small difference in flex/fracture/readable surface, labeled conceptual comparison. No fake kitchen test.
approaches.lighting: Broad soft key on object creates a controlled highlight; analytical model has flat illumination and deliberate visible abstraction. Same lighting across possible outcome comparison; gloss is not a crystal-form diagnosis.
approaches.metaphorVersusLiteral: Object shape is a generic chocolate illustration; interiors are explanatory models, not physically simulated chemistry. Network is a schematic relationship, not a literal invented skeleton.
approaches.microscopicModel: Clearly labeled SIMPLIFIED EXPLANATORY MODEL. Keep sugar/cocoa solids present and visually distinct as fat ordering changes. Use local packing motifs only as symbols of arrangements; larger neighboring crystal domains show network separately. No Form V/VI labels or exact unit cells.
approaches.mobile: Large slab and domains, limited concurrent labels, two structural scales shown sequentially. Ingredient key/disclosure must remain readable; predicted comprehension is untested until production/device QA.
approaches.motion: Deliberate settling of schematic domains, not random Brownian swarm or explosive lattice collapse. Only the fat structure changes through sufficient melt; placement indicates possible configurations, not measured kinetics.
approaches.music: Recommend no music for this specific short; silence, sparse original tonal music and tactile-only mixes considered. Any later switch remains a considered story choice, not universal policy.
approaches.narration: Kokoro af_heart under existing primary narrator policy; conversational precise delivery, no auditions or generated audio.
approaches.pacing: Exact 80 words; allow arrangement/network distinction to register. Editorial 35–41.3 second estimate, later measured audio determines authored timing; no threshold padding.
approaches.payoff: Return from model to intact object, show schematic controlled fracture and clean surface highlight; same-recipe label persists while internal structure resolves. Same recipe/different structure remains visible, not perfect crystal claim.
approaches.rights: Original authored material or original recorded food; no scientific figures, copied microscopy, commercial food footage or third-party music without specific provenance/license review.
risks: Network-as-framework metaphor may overstate physical geometry
Appetite visuals can distract from understanding
Gloss/softness animations must not certify sample states
approaches.sound: Voice-led, no continuous music bed. Sparse original handling/soft flow accents at object-scale transitions; one illustrative dry fracture accent at payoff outside words. Analytical views mostly silent; no audible molecular activity or real-experiment implication.
strengths: Can distinguish fat, solids, arrangement and network without footage
Payoff reconnects mechanism to familiar material behavior
approaches.texture: Cocoa surface with restrained realistic sheen and original roughness variation; abstract fat/solid regions matte and diagrammatic. No photoreal generated microscopy.
approaches.thesis: Keep one chocolate specimen recognizable while exposing two distinct levels of its structure.
tradeoffs: Original 3D art/material and legibility work required; no production components assumed
Internal explanation can look like pseudo-microscopy unless abstraction/disclosure remains obvious
Realistic surface and abstract interior require deliberate transition
approaches.transitions: Section opening reveals fat/solids; analytical window expands along a stable axis; state changes dissolve/rebuild the fat structure while solid-particle identities persist; inset retracts to same specimen for payoff.
approaches.typography: One humanist sans family with double-storey letterforms; sentence-case regular/medium captions, semibold short labels. Avoid decorative serif, huge stacked numerical headings and all-caps shouted captions. Exact font files/weights/license to be pinned after direction approval, no system fallback.
approaches.visualMedium: Original authored 3D material cutaway with explicitly schematic analytical insets

approaches.artDirection: Bold but spare printlike material study with broad cocoa shapes, mineral-gray ground, muted rose/cream analytical marks; no pseudophotography.
approaches.camera: Locked planar composition, no simulated lens or physical scale claim.
approaches.captions: Sentence-case two-line phrases in distinct reading zone, minimal fade; preserve qualifiers.
approaches.composition: One stable rectangular section; large irregular solids embedded in fat, arrangement inset then larger network. Short labels separate from captions.
approaches.hook: Same ingredient marks transform into different relationships without any change to their identity.
approaches.lighting: Illustrated tone separation; no realistic specular laboratory appearance.
approaches.metaphorVersusLiteral: Entire scene openly a model. Avoid tidy bricks versus messy spaghetti as universal good/bad science.
approaches.microscopicModel: Repeated abstract domain marks, disclosed packing symbols and retained sugar/cocoa dots; not microscopic crystal photographs.
approaches.mobile: Highest scale/contrast control; material sensation weaker and abstractions need careful labels.
approaches.motion: Planar slow reforming, no elastic caption bounce or object swarm.
approaches.music: Silence preferred for analytical clarity; a very low original pulse only if later listening materially benefits.
approaches.narration: Kokoro af_heart under existing primary narrator policy; conversational precise delivery, no auditions or generated audio.
approaches.pacing: Exact 80 words; allow arrangement/network distinction to register. Editorial 35–41.3 second estimate, later measured audio determines authored timing; no threshold padding.
approaches.payoff: Material section returns to bar silhouette and conceptual fracture/gloss symbols.
approaches.rights: Original authored material or original recorded food; no scientific figures, copied microscopy, commercial food footage or third-party music without specific provenance/license review.
risks: Regular symbols can imply unit-cell fidelity or fixed particle proportions
Texture ornaments may obscure factual relationships
approaches.sound: Sparse original soft paper/material ticks optional, no claim they are crystal sounds; silence under structural explanation. Subtle original music possible but may imply urgency.
approaches.texture: Subtle original print grain, not copied paper/scientific plate.
approaches.thesis: A graphic material print changes internal organization while its ingredient marks remain invariant.
tradeoffs: Can feel like an infographic rather than chocolate
Risks flattening crystal arrangement and network into one graphic pattern
Ease of procedural rendering gives zero ranking advantage
approaches.transitions: Graphic masks and shape changes expose inner organization; direct comparison persists without endless infographic cards.
approaches.typography: Graphic humanist sans with weight contrast; payoff modest repeated phrase instead of giant poster headline.
approaches.visualMedium: Original flat 2D sectional illustration and kinetic editorial typography

selectionBasis: Best causal continuity and distinction of two structural scales with tangible payoff. No renderer, asset, voice availability or production convenience ranking advantage. Feasibility is a tradeoff, not topic/truth preference.
